Behind the decisions that keep endurance racing fair lies a wealth of knowledge, experience and dedication. 🙌
Go behind the scenes with the FIA World Endurance Championship Stewards and discover what it takes to officiate at the highest level of endurance racing. 👀
Watch more on the FIA YouTube channel NOW! 🔗
#FIA #FIAVolunteersOfficialsMonth
